summary: Filana Therapeutics filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that on October 16, 2026 the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit vacated the Texas District Court's order granting class certification in a securities class action against the company and certain officers and employees. The Fifth Circuit held the district court misapplied the legal standard, failing to evaluate market-inefficiency evidence and improperly rejecting meme-stock-dynamics arguments for the September 14, 2020 to October 12, 2023 class period. Proceedings return to the district court on remand; no efficiency determination was made. This is litigation news, not a special situation; watch remand outcomes and potential class scope.
